operation_title: This method terminates an existing subscription. This method shall support the URI query parameters specified in table 6.1.3.5.3.1-1.
notes: No query parameters are defined for this method.
This method shall support the request data structures specified in table 6.1.3.5.3.1-2 and the response data structures and response codes specified in table 6.1.3.5.3.1-3.
No request body data structures are defined for this method.

NOTE: The mandatory HTTP error status codes for the PUT method listed in Table 5.2.7.1-1 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4] other than those specified in the table above also apply, with a ProblemDetails data type (see subclause 5.2.7 of 3GPP TS 29.500 [4]).

constraints.statement: The DELETE operation shall use the URI {apiRoot}/nnrf-nfm/v1/subscriptions/{subscriptionID}.
The URI shall include the path variable subscriptionID.
The DELETE operation shall not define any query parameters.
The DELETE operation shall not define a request body.
A successful DELETE response shall return 204 No Content.
A 204 No Content response shall not include a response body.
The operation shall support the mandatory HTTP error status codes applicable from 3GPP TS 29.500 Table 5.2.7.1-1, except those already specified in the operation table.
Any supported HTTP error response shall use the ProblemDetails data type.
